about_the_game:
Team up with two squadmates and parkour your way through towering cityscapes as you hunt down your enemies. Play as uniquely skilled heroes, tame your Buddy pets, and unlock hundreds of tactical combos to outsmart your opponents. With unlimited respawns, you're free to charge into the fray, break armor, and go all-out without fear! If you've got the guts, you've got the power to forge your own path to victory!

Strike Fast, Strike Hard!

Prepare to drop into a 60-player battlefield that pushes every limit!

From open fields to vertical cities, team up and let the bullets fly! Run, climb, and fight your way to victory!

Loot gear in tight alleyways, wall-run and slide between rooftops, zipline across bridges to reach the high ground, or launch across the map in a giant Rat Cannon. With layered, dynamic map design, every battle delivers endless exciting moments.

It's not just about pulling the trigger—you'll need to think on your feet and adapt on the fly. Make a mistake? No sweat. Your squad's got your six. Even if you go down, you'll be back in action in seconds and ready to strike back!

Immersive Shooter Action!

Feel every shot. This is gunplay that makes you one with your weapon.

Realistic hit reactions, immersive spatial audio, fluid movement... Get ready for a gunfight that blurs the line between game and reality.

From the moment you fire to when the shot lands, 17 systems work in sync within 0.1 seconds to make everything feel right. When a shot lands, you'll see bursts of impact effects and hear armor cracking. It's the kind of feedback that gets your adrenaline going!

Hear that?! That's not just armor breaking—there are footsteps upstairs too! In this ultra-realistic battlefield, every sound matters. Gunfire distance, footstep speed, surface texture—they're all designed to help you pinpoint enemy movements!

Think Fast, Win Smart!

Each hero brings something different. So get ready to upgrade and expand your tactical playbook!

Choose your moment, unleash your skills, and nail that kill! And don't forget your Buddies—these tactical pets show up randomly, and they're game-changers! They can summon storms, shift zones, disguise the terrain, steal items while invisible... They're unpredictable, powerful, and always bring surprises to the fight!

Try combining your weapons, heroes, and Buddies in different ways, and you'll discover dozens of new ways to win!

Start with a "sky fortress": use Maychelle's Ultimate to summon a high platform, load it up with gear, and turn it into an impenetrable stronghold. Climb up and dominate the battlefield from above!

Pair Beau's bombing abilities with Sparky, and deliver nonstop bombardment that turns every fight into a work of explosive art!

Combine Freddie's teleportation skill with Squeaky. Dash up close, deal damage, then blink back. It's guerrilla warfare at its finest!

There's no one way to win. Every shot opens up new possibilities!

So gear up, grab your gun, and show the world what you're made of in Farlight 84!

name: Farlight 84

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6300 or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce® GTX 660 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500, AMD Ryzen 5 1500x or Equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce® GTX 1060 5G, AMD RX5500XT, Intel Arc A580 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
